label: 阿里妈妈 Alimama
terms_note: ISV programme on the 淘宝开放平台 (open.taobao.com) with merchant authorization; search results describe the product consolidation (万相台无界版 merging 直通车 / 引力魔方 / 万相台) but no readable API reference. Free API; ISV approval.

auth: 1. Become an ISV on the 淘宝开放平台 and apply for the 阿里妈妈 / 直通车 API category.
2. Merchant (advertiser) authorizes the app → session key.

fields.name: app_key
fields.help: AppKey of a 淘宝开放平台 application granted the 阿里妈妈 万相台无界 API permission (https://open.taobao.com).

fields.name: app_secret
fields.help: AppSecret of that application; never sent, used for the MD5 request signature.

fields.name: session
fields.help: Seller session key (授权信息 'session') issued when the merchant authorised the app through the TOP OAuth flow (https://open.taobao.com/doc.htm?docId=101617&docType=1: session is required for APIs marked 需要授权); renew it by re-authorising when it expires.

config_fields.name: biz_code
config_fields.help: 万相台无界 scene code (api业务线编码) sent in top_service_context, e.g. onebpDisplay (人群推广), onebpSearch (关键词推广) or onebpSite (全站推广); taobao.universalbp.new.account.get.can.use.bizcode lists the codes the account may use.

adapter.terms: 淘宝开放平台 TOP (https://open.taobao.com/doc.htm?docId=101617&docType=1): every call goes to https://eco.taobao.com/router/rest with method, app_key, session, timestamp ('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，时区为GMT+8', within 10 minutes), v=2.0, sign_method=md5 and sign = MD5(secret + sorted name/value pairs + secret) in upper case; complex parameters are JSON strings. Failures answer {error_response: {code, msg, sub_code, sub_msg}}; business results carry top_result.info.ok. The 万相台无界 API group is free but 'must be authorised by the user'.

me.note: taobao.universalbp.new.account.get.can.use.bizcode (获取账户可用的bizCode): the marketing scenes the authorised account can use, each {biz_code, app_id, market_name}.

list_campaigns.note: taobao.universalbp.new.campaign.findpage (查询计划分页列表) for the configured biz_code scene, paged with campaign_query_v_o {offset, page_size}. Each campaign has campaign_id, campaign_name, display_status (start 正在推广, pause 暂停推广, terminate, wait, pending, wait_pay), online_status, dmc_type and day_budget (a string in 元, left in raw), launch_time, promotion_scene, optimize_target. account_id and status are not sent (the session selects the shop; status_list would need its own JSON array).

get_report.note: taobao.universalbp.new.report.query.campaign (计划报表查询): per day and campaign (query_domains date, campaign; split_type day; last-click attribution zhai over 15 days) with ad_pv, click, charge (花费, 元), ctr, ecpc; first 100 rows. campaign_id is not applied (filter rows by campaign_id); account_id is not sent (the session selects the shop).

update_budget.note: taobao.universalbp.new.campaign.budget.batchupdate (批量更新计划预算) with budget_list [{campaign_id, dmc_type: normal (日预算), day_budget (元)}]. This spends money. A rejected campaign is reported inside a successful response (raw.campaign_budget_update_result_v_o_top_part_data.error_details, info.ok) rather than as an error. currency is ignored (CNY).

pause_resume.note: pause → taobao.universalbp.new.campaign.oneclick (一键暂停), resume → taobao.universalbp.new.campaign.onerecover (一键恢复, https://open.taobao.com/api.htm?docId=70472&docType=2), each with one_click_v_o {campaign_id_list: [campaign_id]}; the answer is top_result.info {ok, message, error_code} (see raw). Resuming restarts spend.

not_offered.list_accounts: The 万相台无界 API works on the shop whose seller authorised the session; its account calls report balances (taobao.universalbp.new.account.get.balance), usable scenes (…account.get.can.use.bizcode) and whether the shop is a 无界 user, but none lists ad accounts (https://open.taobao.com/api.htm?docId=68584&docType=2, 万相台无界API group).
